stories.title: Welsh house prices rise 1.6 per cent as UK prices fall, Lloyds index shows
stories.summary: House prices in Wales rose by 1.6 per cent over the past year while prices across the UK fell, according to the latest Lloyds House Price Index. The typical property in Wales is now valued at £233,116, Lloyds said. Across the UK, prices fell by 0.6 per cent in October, taking the average to £296,285.

stories.title: Families on Universal Credit urged to register for Year 7 and 8 free school meals

stories.title: Flintshire council warns of scams as landlines move to digital
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has warned residents that scammers may pose as BT as households are contacted about the end of traditional landlines. The old analogue phone network is due to close by 31 January 2027, and the council said scammers may attempt to exploit this transition period, posing as legitimate representatives to obtain personal information.

stories.title: Flu season starts early in Wales as Public Health Wales urges eligible groups to get vaccinated
stories.summary: The flu season has started in Wales earlier than usual, according to Public Health Wales.
